explanation: erdosproblems.com/652: 'It is trivial that R(x_1) = 1 is possible.' The Lean statement: for n ≥ 2 there is an n-point set with a point at a single distance from all the others (e.g. the centre of a circle carrying the other points). n ≥ 2 is needed since a singleton has no distances. Faithful.
